claim: The card re-teaches かきます "Write", which chapter-17/kakimasu already ships with the same target and the same English, so the learner gets a second note for one word and sense.
evidence: Book: Lesson 19 lists no かきます in any VOCABULARY box; it only appears inside Exercise II/III (なまえを かきます → なまえを かいてください). Ledger: Lesson 17 "かきます | Write" (chapter-17/kakimasu). This card: かきます / "Write", scene "writing your name or address on a form". Not in preflight output or .preflight-accepted.json.
fix: Exclude kakimasu-l19 as already taught by chapter-17/kakimasu, as the backward dedup did for まちます, かします and みせます.

claim: The base unit cards a named facility, とうきょうタワー, as a vocabulary word, which the shared rules say is not a card.
evidence: Book VOCABULARY (Exercise VI): "とうきょうタワー Tokyo Tower". Card tokyo-tower: とうきょうタワー / "Tokyo Tower". docs/card-rules-shared.md: "A named facility is not, even a real one: a station, an airport, a stadium or a venue".
fix: Exclude tokyo-tower and leave the name inside taxi-near-tokyo-tower, where the book put it.

claim: The base unit cards a named station, えびすえき, as a vocabulary word, which the shared rules say is not a card.
evidence: Book VOCABULARY: "えびすえき Ebisu Station" with the sub-entry "えびす Ebisu (district in Tokyo)". Card ebisu-eki: えびすえき / "Ebisu Station". docs/card-rules-shared.md names a station as a business-shaped name to leave in sentences.
fix: Exclude ebisu-eki; the district えびす is the entry to card (see chapter-19/-/book-gap/1), and taxi-to-ebisu-station keeps the station name in its sentence.

claim: The book glosses the district えびす as its own vocabulary entry and no card teaches it.
evidence: Book VOCABULARY (Exercise VI B): "えびすえき Ebisu Station ... えびす Ebisu (district in Tokyo)". No card in chapter-19 or chapter-19-extras has target えびす, and the ledger has none earlier. Shared rules: districts "are ordinary vocabulary and do count".
fix: Add a base card えびす / "Ebisu (district in Tokyo)", replacing ebisu-eki.

claim: A named street is carded as a vocabulary word; it is closer to a named facility than to a district, and the common noun it is built on (とおり, street) is not taught.
evidence: Book VOCABULARY: "ぎんざどおり Ginza Street". Card ginza-dori: ぎんざどおり / "Ginza Street". Extras taxi-go-straight-ginza-street already uses the name in the book's sentence.
fix: Owner to decide whether a street counts as a place; if not, exclude ginza-dori and keep the extras sentence.

claim: つぎの is not a Lesson 19 vocabulary entry, and it repeats つぎ "Next" from Lesson 16 with only the particle の added.
evidence: Book: つぎの appears only inside sentences (KS3 "つぎの しんごうを みぎに まがってください"), never in a VOCABULARY box. Ledger: Lesson 16 "つぎ | Next". Card tsugi-no: つぎの / "Next", hint "the form that attaches to a following noun".
fix: Exclude tsugi-no as already taught by chapter-16's つぎ; the many つぎの… sentences in the extras carry the usage.

claim: The English adds "just" to さき, borrowing the word the book uses for てまえ and blurring the book's beyond / just-before contrast.
evidence: Book: "さき beyond", "てまえ just before"; Exercise IV C2 "がっこうの さき". Card: がっこうのさきをまがってください / "Please turn just beyond the school." Base card saki: "Beyond".

claim: The English adds "just" to さき, the word the book reserves for てまえ "just before".
evidence: Book: "さき beyond"; Exercise IV A2 "しんごうの さき". Card: しんごうのさきでとめてください / "Please stop just beyond the traffic light." Its partner taxi-stop-before-intersection correctly reads "just before" for てまえ.
fix: English: "Please stop beyond the traffic light."

claim: The note says ほうこくします is a spoken report to a superior, set against レポート as the written one; the book glosses it only as "report" and never makes that split.
evidence: Book VOCABULARY: "ほうこくします report"; dialogue: "げつようびの かいぎで ほうこくしてください". Card note: "A formal, spoken or business report to a superior. It is a verb, unlike レポート (repōto) "Report" from Lesson 18, the written document."
fix: Keep only the verb-versus-noun contrast with レポート and drop "spoken" and "to a superior".

claim: The card uses とめます in the sense "park", which the book never gives; the book's とめます is "stop", and only the AI-written tomeru-dict-form gloss adds "park".
evidence: Book: "とめます (R2) stop", used for a taxi (ぎんこうの まえで とめてください). Card: ちょっとまってください。バイクをとめます / "Please wait a moment. I'll park the motorbike." Base tomemasu: "Stop"; tomeru-dict-form: "Stop, park (dictionary form)".
fix: Add a note that とめます also means "park" a vehicle, or reword to the book's sense.
